selected_problem: Fresh-main semantic graph assumes repo-relative paths but accepted parent escapes and absolute host paths as semantic nodes, allowing repository context to contain identities outside the declared repository boundary.
decision_basis: The defect is narrow, directly falsifiable, and affects repository-reality integrity before ranking or context selection.
Existing core/path-boundary.mjs already establishes fail-closed workspace-boundary policy, so this cycle reuses an existing sovereignty rule rather than inventing a new product architecture.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime returned transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.impact: Out-of-repository identities could enter semantic nodes and bounded context as if they were canonical repository files.

change: Semantic graph path normalization now rejects POSIX absolute paths, Windows drive-absolute paths, and lexical parent escapes with SEMANTIC_PATH_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY while preserving valid parent-segment aliases that normalize inside the repository.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: fresh main accepts out-of-repository semantic paths.

truth_boundary: This closes lexical repository-boundary escapes in the graph-only repo-relative path model. It does not dereference filesystem paths, establish case/Unicode filesystem identity, add provenance arbitration, or solve complete parser-grade module semantics and arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
